A LITTLE GAME

If Aayush Were...

a colour

Dusty blue. Calm on the surface, more going on underneath than he lets on.

a weather

Overcast, but somehow the good kind. Never dramatic, always comfortable.

a place

A cafeteria table that turned out to be load-bearing for an entire relationship.

a season

Early autumn. Nothing urgent, everything pleasant.

a food

Coffee. Obviously. It's basically a personality trait at this point.

an object

A worn-in hoodie. Familiar, a little chaotic, impossible to replace.

a star

A quiet one. Doesn't need to be the brightest to be the one I keep finding.

OKAY... ONE LAST THING

The Letter

open me

06 · 09

Aayush,

I don't think I ever properly said this, so let me say it now, in the quietest part of this whole silly little world: I'm grateful I met you. Not the way people say things out of habit — the way you mean something you've turned over in your hands for years and still aren't tired of.

You didn't just become someone in my life. Somehow, you became a collection of my favourite memories — the calm ones, the chaotic ones, the ones that made no sense until you were in them.

I hope this year gives you every ridiculous, beautiful thing you deserve. And I hope you know — you became home in ways I never expected, and never once had to try for.

Happy birthday, Mr. Heartless.

— Bubbu
